source_policy: Primary official sources only; registry metadata is used for published package facts; documentation claims are not substituted for prototype execution evidence.
currentness_policy: Words such as current, stable, and latest are observations at the cutoff. Scheduled releases after the cutoff are not treated as available.
locator_policy: Prefer immutable release tags and full commits; use section anchors for standards/policy; record a short tag commit when GitHub did not expose the full object through the retrieved page.

failures.request: Initial search-index current Lean/Mathlib release resolution
failures.outcome: stale result labeled v4.30.0 as latest
failures.preservation: Re-querying the live official release lists showed standalone Lean v4.32.2 latest and Mathlib v4.32.1 latest. The tagged Mathlib v4.32.1 lean-toolchain names Lean v4.32.1, so v4.30.0 was rejected as current and v4.32.1 retained as the latest matching pair.
Repository license classification retained from the official repository page; no raw-file quotation used.

failures.request: Direct Rust/Cargo 2026 advisory URLs inferred from the Rust blog index
failures.preservation: No claim that a particular compiler/Cargo release fixes CVE-2026-5222 or CVE-2026-5223. RustSec is cited only for crate advisory infrastructure.

failures.request: GitHub API full tag objects for Julia v1.12.6, Julia v1.10.11, Arrow 25.0.0, and Lean v4.30.0
failures.outcome: safe-URL rejection; Julia/Arrow commit-link clicks also returned internal error
failures.preservation: Immutable release URLs and exposed short commits are recorded; full commits are not fabricated. Lean full commit was available from its commit page.

failures.request: Formal Julia core SECURITY.md or equivalent policy
failures.preservation: Security governance is described only as emerging based on the official Security Working Group post.

failures.request: Formal fixed multi-version support horizon for R
failures.outcome: not stated on the official release/developer pages reviewed
failures.preservation: Annual cadence is not promoted to a support-duration guarantee.

failures.request: cbor2 canonical map ordering variant in stable API docs
failures.outcome: API states canonical/sorted output but does not name RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 or 4.2.3
failures.preservation: Marked as a prototype obligation requiring discriminating byte vectors.

prototype_boundary: These files establish source lineage, versions, licenses, policy, and documented limitations. They do not claim that StatQED builds, packages, validates CBOR/CDDL, or round-trips Arrow on any host. Those are prototype/test obligations.
